name: Monforte del Cid (Spain)
description: Horizontally divided white over light blue, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Monforte del Cid (a crowned castle on white within a collar).
history: Municipal flag of Monforte del Cid; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Monforte del Cid arms — castle within a collar
